# `entropy-24-00930-p8.pdf`

Page 8 of Newman, E.L.; Varley, T.F.; Parakkattu, V.K.; Sherrill, S.P.; Beggs, J.M. *Revealing the
Dynamics of Neural Information Processing with Multivariate Information Decomposition.* Entropy
2022, 24, 930. <https://doi.org/10.3390/e24070930>

© 2022 by the authors. Licensee MDPI, Basel, Switzerland. An open access article distributed under
the Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY 4.0) licence. Cut to a single page, unmodified otherwise,
with pdf-lib.

**Why it is here.** It is the page of a reader's report
([SPIDERYARN-READING2-31](../../../docs/plans/260912a-figure-2-vector-figures-from-a-pdf.md)):
Figure 2 is drawn as 58 vector paths with its labels set as text, and the page carries no bitmap at
all, so the bitmap route records `no-raster`. Its caption begins "Figure 2. Partial information
lattices." at y ≈ 451 pt, and the drawing fills the band above it.
